## What's new

### A redesigned look
- **A new design throughout.** The title bar and sidebar share one calm frame, with consistent rounded corners, soft layered shadows, and a new bundled interface font, Manrope.
- **Calligraphic surah frames.** The first page of every surah now has a frame like a printed Mushaf. The style (Madinah, Ottoman or IndoPak) follows your theme, IndoPak script always uses the IndoPak frame, and surah names are set in calligraphy.
- **A clearer switch** between Verse by Verse and Reading.
- **New icons** (Lucide) across the title bar, sidebar, reader bar and player.
- **Matching menus and screens.** Menus, dialogs, pickers and the welcome screens are restyled to fit.

### Simpler Settings
- **Seven clear areas.** Settings are regrouped into Appearance, Mushaf & script, Translation & tafsir, Listening, Offline, Reminders and App, with content using the wider window and larger theme previews.
- **Related options merged.** There is one Mushaf choice (Madani pages, IndoPak pages or text fonts), one "follow the reciter" setting (off, follow, lock), one player bar setting (on demand, always, auto-hide) and one text size for translation and tafsir. Your existing choices carry over.
- **New sliders and toggles** throughout.
- **Removed:** focus mode, auto-hide of the window chrome, the reminder preview and test buttons, and the highlight style choice (the sweep highlight stays).

### Tafsir and offline reading
- **Read tafsir verse by verse.** Choose a commentary edition beside the translation, or keep it matched to the translation language. Each verse has its own toggle, so you can open commentary only where you want it.
- **Save tafsir for offline use.** The Offline manager now includes audio and tafsir, with edition and surah controls for downloading and deleting saved content.
- **Bengali is ready out of the box.** Noto Sans Bengali is bundled with the app, so Bengali translations and tafsir display even when the system has no Bengali font installed.
- **Adjust tafsir text size** in Settings.

### Improvements
- Network failures while loading audio, translations, or tafsir now offer a retry action.
- The verse-by-verse tafsir controls and Offline manager have been refined for clearer layout and theme consistency.
- Website updates improve the step-section scrolling, the return-to-top button, and search indexing metadata.
